metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a median nerve glide that can help relieve carpal tunnel syndrome numbness and pain within seconds.

Carpal tunnel syndrome is an overuse injury where repetitive hand and wrist movements irritate and inflame the median nerve. The common symptoms of this are numbness, tingling, pain and weakness in (and around) the thumb, pointer finger, and middle finger.

This exercise can be done at home, requires no equipment, and can be done throughout the day.

Let us know how it works for you!
